title: In Splunk Enterprise versions below 10.6.1, 10.4.5, 10.2.9, 10.0.12, and 9.4.17, an unauthenticated user could run…
description: Splunk Enterprise versions below 10.6.1, 10.4.5, 10.2.9, 10.0.12, and 9.4.17 contain a vulnerability allowing unauthenticated users to execute arbitrary SPL searches via RapidDiag task collection. This occurs because the product accepts an empty shared secret during authentication of RapidDiag requests, enabling unauthorized access to data and configuration accessible to authenticated users.
